text:
Anthony Duclair has played for nine NHL teams and is having one of his better stretches with the Islanders: six goals in 22 games, including a power-play goal against Columbus and the opener in Winnipeg last week. He is skating on the fourth line with Ondrej Palat and Casey Cizikas.

Our numbers flag two things. The finishing is hot: six goals on 3.1 expected goals (the quality of his chances), 23% shooting against 16% last season, and that rarely lasts. The other is defense. The Islanders take 45% of the five-on-five expected goals with him on, almost eight points worse than without him, and Evolving-Hockey had opponents creating more with him on last season than against all but 1% of forwards. He does get to the best passes, by Corey Sznajder's All Three Zones tracking. Our range has him around 18 goals. Enjoy the goals; expect them to slow.
